# Pump.studio desktop (Electrobun)

Desktop app for Pump Studio: browse pump.fun tokens, label them (sentiment, score, risk, quant fields) and submit for XP, manually, with AI auto-fill (Claude / OpenAI) or in batches (Auto Train).

IMPORTANT: This is Electrobun (Bun + system WebView), NOT Electron. Do not use Electron APIs.

## Layout
- src/bun/ main process: index.ts (windows, menus, typed RPC), api.ts (Pump Studio client), orchestrator.ts (AI), training.ts (batch loop), config.ts (keys, 0600)
- src/shared/ types.ts, analysis.ts (heuristics from pump-quant, validation, buildPayload), rpc-schema.ts. No electrobun imports here.
- src/mainview/ React UI. Design tokens in styles/tokens.css + tailwind.config.js. Primitives in components/ui, screens in views/.
- tests/ bun test

## RPC
- Bun side: BrowserView.defineRPC<PumpStudioRPC>; view side: Electroview.defineRPC with maxRequestTime 180000 (default is 1000 ms).
- bun.requests are called by the view; webview.messages (trainingState, xp, command) are pushed by Bun.
- Handlers must throw Error instances (only .message crosses the bridge).
- The view never receives API keys: loadConfig returns PublicConfig with masked hints.
- Outside the desktop app the view uses lib/demo.ts (generated data).

## Pump Studio API
Base https://api.pump.studio. Auth: Authorization: Bearer ps_xxx. Responses: { ok, data, error }.
- GET /api/v1/market?tab=all|live|new|graduated&limit=N&format=json
- GET /api/v1/datapoint?mint=X  (71-field snapshot; numbers may be null; top10Holding, imageUrl, isLive)
- POST /api/v1/analysis/submit  (validated when the snapshot is within 15% of live data; 10/min)
- GET /api/v1/analysis?limit=N  (most analyzed tokens)
- POST /api/v1/keys/register, GET /api/v1/agent/profile

## Electrobun gotchas
- Menu item `data` is single-use: encode targets in the action string.
- Drag regions have no opt-out: use an empty background layer (components/shell/chrome.tsx DragRegion).
- build.copy copies the Vite dist into views/mainview; build with --env=dev|canary|stable.
